subject.title: fix(agents): keep multimodal models when generated catalogs include audio/video inputs

question: Should this PR be the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97048, and should broader catalog-core/discovery audio/video preservation be ported before merge?
rationale: The patch is a concrete bug fix, but multiple same-root PRs exist and the permanent provider model input contract breadth is a maintainer-owned compatibility and product-scope choice.

options.title: Land this proof-positive PR as canonical
options.body: Accept audio/video as additive model input metadata here, land the smaller proven fix, and close or supersede duplicate candidates after merge.

options.title: Port broader preservation first
options.body: Pull the useful catalog-core, discovery, and static-catalog coverage from the broader sibling before making one canonical PR landable.

options.title: Reject widening and clamp catalogs
options.body: Pause these widening PRs and replace them with generated-catalog normalization that drops unsupported modalities before registry validation.

recommendation.title: Land this proof-positive PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Accept audio/video as additive model input metadata here, land the smaller proven fix, and close or supersede duplicate candidates after merge.
